description: This source file defines the MmsMessagingDemo class, an Android activity providing a user interface for sending and receiving MMS messages. It manages MMS message construction, sending, downloading, and display within the demo app, including handling MMS status updates and interactions with the Android telephony and messaging APIs.

classes.name: MmsMessagingDemo
classes.description: An Android Activity class providing MMS messaging functionality including sending, receiving, and displaying MMS messages within a demo app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting up the UI elements, registering broadcast receivers, and handling intent extras for message download.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Builds an MMS PDU and initiates sending via SmsManager.

methods.name: downloadMessage
methods.description: Initiates download of an MMS message from a specified URL.

methods.name: handleSentResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the MMS send operation, updating UI and cleaning up.

methods.name: handleReceivedResult
methods.description: Processes a downloaded MMS, updating UI with message contents.
